review_candidates.description: Salary £26,300 per year including great benefits including a Health Cash Plan! Home, a place where you belong We have a great opportunity for someone to join our 1st Line Support Administration team. This is a great role for you in an IT environment and is ideal if you’re keen on developing a career in IT, but don’t know where to start! What You’ll Do Responding to requests for new starter accounts to be created Updating and maintaining IT account permissions Monitoring support tickets and assigning these to relevant teams for resolution. Manage account closure requests ensuring systems are deactivated correctly and no risk of access remains Why join us You’ll join a team of administrators and apprentices; we enjoy our jobs and the impact we have on new joiners coming into the business! You’ll quickly discover the wider IS service desk team are a really supportive bunch! Be part of one of the UK’s Great Places to Work! You have Great communication skills and can interact with a wide variety of different colleagues across our large organisation. You’re comfortable using a PC and a number of systems and are not phased by using new systems or applications. The ability to quickly adapt to new situations and are able to tackle issues head on. You’re analytical and systematic when managing requests or following a process. You’re the kind of person who is happy to highlight any opportunities for improvement both within the job and in your own skillset. Prioritising customer needs to provide high-quality service through prompt, precise, and clear communication. Stronger together We do our best work when we’re ourselves. That’s why inclusion, wellbeing, and our diversity networks help make Home Group a great place to work! The practical bits Temporary (6 months), full time (37.5 hpw) You’ll work Monday to Friday, a rotation of earlies (7:00 to 15:30) and lates (09:30 to 18:00) We come into the office a minimum of 2 days per week (more if you want) and work from home the remainder of the time. We can be flexible and work with you to adapt shifts etc as and when you need that! We can’t offer a CoS for this role What’s in it for you? 34 days leave, rising to 39 (this includes bank holidays and a “me day”) 2 paid volunteering days each year Matching pension contribution (up to 7% and life insurance of 3x basic salary) Instant access to pay with Stream 800+ discounts on shops, holidays, days out, tech and more Career path with development and excellent training package. Finally For reasonable adjustments email [email protected]. Roles can close early, so don’t delay applying. If you can’t see the Job Description on this page, click APPLY to view it on our pages and find out more about us.

review_candidates.title: Quality Monitoring-Engish Speakers
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations. The company manages outsourcing agreements for government and commercial clients across multiple sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, serving customers in 10 different languages. Xceed delivers a broad portfolio of services, including inbound and outbound customer support, back office operations, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis. The organization has received numerous international awards for outsourcing excellence, impact sourcing, sustainability, customer experience, diversity, and inclusion. Xceed is certified to multiple global standards, including COPC and several ISO certifications, reflecting its commitment to quality, business continuity, information security, and safe work environments. Role Description The Quality Monitoring Specialist – Excellent English is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo. This role focuses on monitoring and evaluating customer interactions across various channels to ensure adherence to Xceed’s quality standards and client requirements. The specialist reviews calls, chats, and emails, provides detailed feedback to agents and team leaders, and identifies training needs and performance improvement opportunities. Daily tasks include preparing quality reports, analyzing trends, recommending corrective actions, and collaborating with operations and training teams to enhance customer experience and service consistency. The role also involves maintaining updated knowledge of processes, compliance guidelines, and client expectations, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. Requiremnents :- -Experience: Minimum 6 months as a Quality Analyst/Specialist -Experience in the telecommunications industry (e.g., Vodafone, Orange, WE, Vodafone UK, AT&T). Skills: Excellent English communication and strong analytical abilities.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer Intern
review_candidates.description: Student Opportunity: Join Me at GovTech 2026 in Durban I’m looking for an ambitious student based in or around Durban to join me at GovTech 2026 , taking place at the Durban ICC from 21–23 September 2026 . This is a unique opportunity for a student who is interested in technology, entrepreneurship, business, government innovation, sales, marketing or startups and wants to gain firsthand experience in one of South Africa’s biggest technology events. About Mergemega Mergemega is a technology company building products designed to help businesses discover and connect with opportunities in the market. Our main product, SignalMerge , is an AI-powered customer discovery platform that identifies people publicly expressing demand for products and services across online platforms. Instead of businesses having to wait for customers to find them, SignalMerge helps them discover people who are already looking for what they offer . 🌐 https://signalmerge.co.za About the opportunity I’ll be exhibiting SignalMerge at GovTech 2026 and participating in the GovTech pitching challenge on 23 September . I’m looking for someone to work alongside me for all three days of the event. You’ll potentially be involved in: • Representing Mergemega and SignalMerge at our exhibition stand • Speaking with entrepreneurs, technology professionals, government representatives and potential partners • Helping demonstrate and explain SignalMerge to visitors • Networking and identifying interesting people and opportunities • Supporting conversations with potential customers and partners • Learning how a technology startup presents itself to the market • Attending the GovTech pitching challenge and seeing how technology companies pitch to a large audience • Capturing useful insights, contacts and opportunities from the event • Helping with general event and exhibition activities You will not need to be an experienced salesperson or technology expert . I’m more interested in someone who is curious, confident, professional, willing to learn and comfortable speaking to new people. Why this could be valuable for you This isn't simply an opportunity to help at an exhibition. You’ll be surrounded by founders, investors, technology executives, government leaders, innovators and other students and young professionals from across the technology ecosystem. It’s an opportunity to: 🤝 Build your professional network 💡 Learn directly from founders and technology professionals 🚀 Gain practical startup experience 🎤 Develop your communication and networking skills 🏢 Understand how technology companies interact with government and enterprise 👩‍💻 Meet other young people and entrepreneurs building careers in technology 🌍 Discover potential career and business opportunities And importantly, something longer-term could come from this. If we work well together and there is a strong mutual fit, this opportunity could potentially lead to a 6-month internship with Mergemega after GovTech. That is not guaranteed , but I want to be transparent that I’m open to exploring a longer-term opportunity with the right person. Who I'm looking for You should: ✅ Be a current student ✅ Be based in or around Durban ✅ Be available for all three days: 21, 22 and 23 September ✅ Have a genuine interest in technology, startups, business or entrepreneurship ✅ Be confident communicating with new people ✅ Be professional and presentable ✅ Be curious, proactive and willing to learn ✅ Be comfortable representing a startup in a professional environment Accommodation can be arranged if you live outside Durban , and food will be provided during the event. If you're a student who thinks this sounds like something you'd be interested in, send me a DM with a short introduction about yourself, what you're studying, and why you'd like to attend GovTech with me. I'm looking for someone who is excited to get involved, meet people and make the most of the opportunity. Applications are open now. #GovTech2026 #StudentOpportunity #Internship #Technology #Startups #Entrepreneurship #Durban #SouthAfrica #TechJobs #Mergemega #SignalMerge
